The '''xandank lance''' was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] in the form of a [[Polearm/Legends|polearm]] which saw use during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It shared the same name as the [[Xandank/Legends|xandank]] creature.<ref name="TOW" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Xandank lances appeared in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|Trials of Obi-Wan]], a [[2005]] expansion pack for the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="TOW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
